layouts_identity_valid.name: layouts_identity_valid
layouts_identity_valid.value: length(btrim("layouts"."id")) between 1 and 200 and length(btrim("layouts"."site_id")) between 1 and 200

layouts_data_identity.name: layouts_data_identity
layouts_data_identity.value: jsonb_typeof("layouts"."data") = 'object' and "layouts"."data" ?& array['layoutId', 'siteId', 'parentId'] and ("layouts"."data"->>'layoutId') is not distinct from "layouts"."id" and ("layouts"."data"->>'siteId') is not distinct from "layouts"."site_id" and ("layouts"."data"->>'parentId') is not distinct from "layouts"."parent_id"

scenarios_agent_rationale.name: scenarios_agent_rationale
scenarios_agent_rationale.value: "scenarios"."author" <> 'agent' or ("scenarios"."rationale" is not null and btrim("scenarios"."rationale") <> '')

scenarios_agent_never_founder.name: scenarios_agent_never_founder
scenarios_agent_never_founder.value: "scenarios"."author" <> 'agent' or "scenarios"."parent_id" is not null or not jsonb_path_exists("scenarios"."overrides", '$.**.origin ? (@ == "founder")')
